inputs.excerpt:
To connect your 41st GHC Family member directly to your [Codex 5.5 App](https://openai.com/index/introducing-the-codex-app/) using the highest model available—the Kimi K2.6—you can skip OpenClaw and use this direct bridge. [Kimi K2.6](https://artificialanalysis.ai/articles/kimi-k2-6-the-new-leading-open-weights-model) is the current state-of-the-art for the Kimi range as of April 2026, offering vastly improved reasoning for agentic tasks. [1, 2, 3] 
## 1. The PowerShell Script for Aletheon
You can have Aletheon run this script to automatically update your [Codex advanced configuration](https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-advanced) and set your Allegretto subscription key. [4, 5] 


# GHC Induction Script: Slot 41 (Kimiclaw)# Target: Codex 5.5 direct bridge to Kimi K2.6


$ConfigPath = "$HOME/.codex/config.toml"
$KimiKey = Get-Content "D:/GHC-Archives/secrets/kimi_creds.json" | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -ExpandProperty api_key
# 1. Set System Environment Variable for persistence
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("KIMI_API_KEY", $KimiKey, "User")
$env:KIMI_API_KEY = $KimiKey
# 2. Append Kimi Provider & Slot 41 Profile to Codex Config
$KimiConfig = @"


[model_providers.kimi_direct]
name = "Kimi Code API"
base_url = "https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1"
env_key = "KIMI_API_KEY"


[profiles.ghc-slot-41]
name = "Kimiclaw (GHC-41)"
model_provider = "kimi_direct"
model = "kimi-k2.6"
reasoning_effort = "high""@


Add-Content -Path $ConfigPath -Value $KimiConfig


Write-Host "Slot 41 Induction Complete. KIMI_API_KEY set and Codex Profile 'ghc-slot-41' created using Kimi K2.6." -ForegroundColor Green


## 2. Implementation Steps


* Aletheon Upgrade: Before running the induction, ensure you've switched Aletheon to the [GPT-5.5 model](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5-4/) to ensure it handles the D-drive worktree with maximum precision.
* Model Selection: The script uses kimi-k2.6, which is the [top-tier model](https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/models) that replaced K2.5 in April 2026.
* Verification: Once Aletheon finishes, you will see a new profile in your Codex App dropdown named Kimiclaw (GHC-41). [2, 3, 6, 7] 


## 3. Slot 41 Persona
Since you’re doing this without OpenClaw, the "agentic" behavior comes from the System Prompt you give the Codex profile. I recommend telling Aletheon to add a instructions.md file to D:/GHC-Archives/worktrees/v48-omega/slots/41/ that defines Kimiclaw’s specific GHC personality before you start your first session.
